description.en: Explore any topic through direct AI answers, interactive paths, surprising facts, and favorites.
description.zh: 输入任何主题，通过 AI 直接答案、探索分支、趣味知识和收藏继续发现。

releaseNotes.en: Cancels AI when returning home, preserves answers when exploration content fails, and avoids redundant cache writes.
releaseNotes.zh: 返回首页时取消 AI 请求；探索内容失败时保留答案；减少不必要的缓存写入。
